name: Invaders of Alterac Valley
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The battle for Alterac rages on! You must return to Alterac Valley and once more drive the invaders out of Frostwolf territory, adventurer!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good work, adventurer! You should be proud of yourself. The Alliance invaders must be expelled from Alterac!
narrative.requestItemsText: What news do you bring from the lands of the Frostwolves?  How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 11,600 XP in all.
